reason: A trajectory visualization and review plugin that reads session/event logs and presents standardized execution traces across web, command-line, headless, SDK, and custom UI surfaces.

summaries.zh: 读取 DeepSeek Harness 的 session/event 日志，在 Web、命令行、无头模式及 SDK 等界面中提供统一的自然语言轨迹可视化、筛选与审查。
summaries.en: Visualizes and reviews DeepSeek Harness session/event logs with consistent natural-language traces, filtering, and report outputs across web, CLI, headless, SDK, and custom UI surfaces.

capabilities: Reads persisted session and event logs
Renders timelines and reports for web, command-line, headless, SDK, and hooks integrations
Supports filtering, review confirmation, and quoting selected or complete records into a conversation draft
Can output text, Markdown, or JSON and optionally write headless output to stderr
Redacts common API keys, tokens, secrets, and passwords in quoted content according to the README
